coordinate_contract.source_glb: glTF Y-up; verify importer orientation in Blender
coordinate_contract.blender: Z-up, meters, apply scale to unskinned WORKING copy only after saving baseline
coordinate_contract.root: one root at world origin; transform identity; non-deform
coordinate_contract.pelvis: direct child of root, Connected OFF; anatomical hip pivot

export_policy.format: GLB/FBX authoring export as validated; Unreal Editor smoke mandatory

classification.HELPER: 4 runtime motion/IK helpers with use_deform=False; root included in hierarchy
classification.SOCKET: 5 Unreal Skeleton sockets, not Blender skin bones
classification.CONTROL: Separate Control Rig; excluded from exported skin

legacy_policy: Preserve original unfitted 92 bone source JSON for provenance; do not merge incompatible skeleton naming/hierarchy into v2 silently
